spans.s:
Regal.
E.
ईश, and अण aff.

f. (-नी)
The north-east quarter.
E.
ईशान ŚIVA, as regent of the north-east, अण् and ङीष् affs.

ind.
The present year.
E.
इदम् this, समसण् aff.

mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
Of or belonging to the present year.
E.
ऐषमस, and त्यय affix; or with द्यु affix, ऐषमस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं).
